files.README.md:
# Kneadwell Bakery - deck oven log, April 2026

One row per oven and day for the first fortnight. An empty cell, a dash or NA
means the oven was not logged that day and the day stays out of averages.
files.notes/bake-schedule.txt:
Deck 1 carries the sourdough bake.
Deck 3 gets its annual service at the end of April.
